architecture.mechanism: Erosion classification system for wind turbine blades
architecture.intervention: Implement a **real-time erosion monitoring system** using embedded sensors (e.g., acoustic emission, vibration, or electrical resistance sensors) along the leading edge to classify erosion severity in situ, triggering targeted protective coatings or repairs during scheduled service windows.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduces unplanned downtime by enabling predictive maintenance, minimizes energy loss by addressing erosion before it degrades performance, and extends blade lifespan by optimizing repair timing.
architecture.falsification_test: Deploy sensors on 10% of blades in a fleet, compare annual energy production and repair frequency against a control group (blades without sensors) over 2 years. Validate classification accuracy via post-service visual inspection and erosion depth measurements.

challenge.kill_reason: all checks passed: evidence verified, no specific disclosure, adversarial survived, falsification concrete
